tools.description: To find the docs.x.ai page for a Grok API topic (prompt caching, function calling, structured outputs, Batch API, rate limits, voice, Imagine) before reading it with get_page.
To compare SuperGrok and X plans, find what a plan includes (Grok Bot, Imagine video, API access, usage multiple) or its price.
To find ready-made Grok Bots for a job or browse a marketplace category before reading one with get_bot_listing.

Generate DISC and OCEAN scores plus selling and hiring outreach guidance from a LinkedIn profile. 20 Firecrawl credits for a completed analysis. A profile AI Ark cannot find is a not_found error and costs nothing.

Check how many people match a people/search filter and see one masked row. 5 Firecrawl credits per call, including an empty page. Last names are masked; no email or phone. The id is real and works with people/email-find.

Connected Socials. One upstream call, 165 Firecrawl credits per call. Pagination is explicit; no automatic enrichment or follow-up calls. Reference: https://docs.influencers.club/openapi/connected-socials/public_v1_creators_socials_create Platform is fixed to X; pass the canonical X profile URL as url.
